text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: difference in mean quantile score over the five decision sites (D5, D10, D11, D14, D16), scored 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026 on rows outside the switching events. Line: 98.33% interval (planned, Bonferroni for three) or 95% interval (exploratory) from resampling whole calendar months. Grey: the first run's forecasts, whose spread carried the replica year's mean bias (95%). Dashed line: no difference.'
text.tspan: Dot: difference in mean quantile score over the five decision sites (D5, D10, D11, D14, D16),
scored 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026 on rows outside the switching events. Line: 98.33% interval
(planned, Bonferroni for three) or 95% interval (exploratory) from resampling whole calendar
months. Grey: the first run's forecasts, whose spread carried the replica year's mean bias
